items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 130:1
items.html: The Chazeh [chest] of every Partzuf and downward is discerned as the aspect of the posterior vessels of that Partzuf, which are the two lower thirds of the Tifferet and the NHYM. And the two lower thirds of the Tifferet are discerned as the front within the posterior. And the essence of the posterior is the NHYM. See above, answer 97. (Items 143 and 145).
